name: Barrel of Shimmer Stout
summary: In Dun Morogh, Rejold Barleybrew sends a barrel of Shimmer Stout to the mountain watch. The experimental ale is meant for guards on the high passes, and drinkers say it brightens their vision.

sections.title: A Brewer's Pride
sections.body: Rejold Barleybrew brewed Shimmer Stout after gathering ingredients across Dun Morogh. The recipe is the latest work of the Barleybrew family, whose dwarven brewers compete to make hearty ales against the mountain cold. Rejold made this stout to warm the gut and sharpen the senses of those posted in the wind.

sections.title: Supplies for the Watch
sections.body: This barrel is bound for Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew at the southern tower on the pass into Loch Modan. Mountaineers there endure cold and long watches between skirmishes with troggs and wildlife. A cask of family ale brings a taste of home, and its kick can leave a tired sentry feeling able to see clearly in the dark.

faq.q: What is in the Barrel of Shimmer Stout?
aliases: what kind of ale is this
faq.answer: The barrel holds Shimmer Stout, an experimental dwarven ale brewed by Rejold Barleybrew. Drinkers say its potent kick brightens their vision.

faq.q: Who made this barrel of stout?
faq.answer: Rejold Barleybrew brewed the stout. He belongs to the Barleybrew family of Dun Morogh and spent time perfecting the recipe to impress his kin.

faq.q: Who is this barrel meant for?
faq.answer: The barrel is meant for Rejold's brother, Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew. Wellart guards the southern tower on the road into Loch Modan.

faq.q: What effect does Shimmer Stout have on someone who drinks it?
aliases: does it make you see in dark
faq.answer: Shimmer Stout delivers a potent buzz and makes drinkers feel as if they can see in pitch darkness. Its kick makes it popular among vigilant mountaineers.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing is a cornerstone of Ironforge society. Bringing a newly perfected stout to a kinsman on watch is an honorable mountain tradition.
As a cook, you know dwarven brewers experiment with hardy mountain ingredients and potent fermentation to make ales for biting weather.
